label: Tasks
description: Manages asynchronous tasks, execution, progress, output, results and cancellation. Tasks expose live handles independently of their execution backend.

taskOptions.description: Options used to create and execute a task.

handler.description: Async function receiving a taskContext and returning the task result.

data.description: Optional input data passed to the handler through context.data.

taskContext.description: Execution context passed to the task handler.

setDescription.description: Function setDescription(description) updating the task description.

setProgress.description: Function setProgress(value, max = 100). Passing null makes progress indeterminate.

err.description: Function err(text) writing to stderr without automatically failing the task.

taskOutput.description: One entry in a task's output stream.

taskOutputPage.description: Page of output entries returned by task.getOutput().

task.description: Live observable Task object. References remain stable while the task is registered.

progress.description: null for indeterminate progress, otherwise an object with value and max.

createdAt.description: Date when the task was registered.

startedAt.description: Date when execution started, or null.

endedAt.description: Date when execution ended, or null.

getOutput.description: Async method getOutput({cursor?, limit?}) returning a taskOutputPage. Output may be retrieved from local memory or a remote server.

getResult.description: Async method getResult() returning the task's result. Waits for successful completion and rejects on error or cancellation. Results may be strings, objects, URLs or file references.

wait.description: Async method wait() resolving when the task reaches finished, error or canceled. Does not reject merely because the task failed.

cancel.description: Async method cancel() requesting cancellation. Resolves when the cancellation request has been processed.

addEventListener.description: Registers a listener for changes to this task.

removeEventListener.description: Removes a previously registered task listener.

taskList.description: Snapshot array of references to live Task objects.

items.description: Live Task object conforming to the task type.

xshell:tasks:added.description: Emitted on the application bus when a task is registered.

xshell:tasks:updated.description: Emitted on the application bus when a task's state, description, progress or output changes.

xshell:tasks:removed.description: Emitted on the application bus when a task is removed.

run.description: Creates and starts a task. Executes options.handler(context) asynchronously and immediately returns a live Task object. A returned value becomes the result; an exception marks the task as failed.

returns.description: The newly created live Task object.

get.description: Returns the registered live Task object by ID, or undefined if not found.

returns.description: The live Task object, or undefined.

list.description: Returns a snapshot array containing references to all registered live Task objects.

clear.description: Removes finished, failed and canceled tasks from the registry. Running tasks are retained.

remove.description: Removes a terminal task from the registry without deleting any files or results produced by the task.
